subject: Enterprise access onboarding: SSO/SCIM, IP allowlists & service-account playbook
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@bankcrest.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Enterprise access onboarding: SSO/SCIM, IP allowlists & service-account playbook

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. I wanted to kick off a single-threaded plan for the access-control portion of our onboarding (SSO/SAML, SCIM provisioning, IP allowlists, and service accounts/org policies). Goal: get the core controls in place for staging by 2027-03-18 and production cutover the week of 2027-03-29.

High-level asks from your side to unblock the implementation team:
- SAML metadata (IdP XML) or Okta metadata link
- SCIM service account + token (temporary/one-time or scoped token is fine)
- IP allowlist CIDR blocks for redwood egress (and preferred maintenance windows for changing allowlists)
- Any naming conventions / restrictions for service accounts and CI/CD principals

I've attached our onboarding checklist and a sample SAML metadata file to show the fields we expect.

Immediate proposal for next steps:
1) You share SAML metadata + SCIM token by EOD 2027-03-09 (or tell us if procurement/security needs more time).
2) Laura will open a Jira (CS-9923) and run the implementation playbook with your infra/security engineer.
3) We schedule a 30-minute implementation sync with banking infra and our infra eng to coordinate IP allowlist changes.

If any of this needs to be routed to your procurement or vendor-security teams, please loop them in — we want to minimize back-and-forth.

Thanks —
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.ai] | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: redwood_onboarding_checklist.xlsx, sample-saml-metadata.xml

From: Emma Liu <emma.liu@bankcrest.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-08T11:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Enterprise access onboarding: SSO/SCIM, IP allowlists & service-account playbook

Jordan —

Appreciate the clear plan. Quick answers:
- Okta metadata is available at https://bankcrest.okta.com/app/meta/bankcrest-redwood.xml (internal link, security-admin@bankcrest.com can provide access if you need it).
- We're generating a SCIM token for Redwood; security wants it scoped and rotated weekly. I can provide an encoded token file once the admin creates the service principal.
- IP allowlist: we prefer changes during the 0100–0400 UTC maintenance window; CIDRs for our outbound will be shared separately.
- Service-account naming: must start with "svc_redwood_" and be registered in our identity catalog (we'll provide the registration link).

I'll loop in our infra/security owner (security-admin@bankcrest.com) if we need a signed SLA/contract note.

Emma Liu
Director, Infrastructure Security
BankCrest Financial
emma.liu@bankcrest.com | +1 212-555-9987

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@bankcrest.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-09T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Enterprise access onboarding: SSO/SCIM, IP allowlists & service-account playbook

Thanks, Emma — good context. I created the Jira ticket CS-9923 and added a short implementation checklist (link in the ticket). Small plan from the CS/implementation side:

Implementation steps (stage -> prod):
1) Staging only: Import SAML metadata into staging connector (we support both raw XML and Okta URL).
2) SCIM: Use the scoped service account token you provide; we'll run a dry-provision in staging (user + group sync sample).
3) IP allowlists: Redwood will present egress ranges for our connectors; schedule the allowlist update within your 0100–0400 UTC window.
4) Service accounts: We'll create redwood-managed principals but follow your registry naming (svc_redwood_*). We'll provide the exact identity URNs for registration.
5) Org policies (entropy/lifecycle): We will enforce MFA and session timeout on admin flows and provide logs routed to your SIEM via the audit export endpoint.

Timing & owners:
- Emma: provide SAML metadata + SCIM token by 2027-03-09 EOD (per Jordan request).
- Vivek (infra): will run the staging import and validate attributes on 2027-03-10.
- Neha (security): will validate provisioning scopes and rotation policy with your security team on 2027-03-11.

If anything blocks those dates, call it out here and we'll re-prioritize. I'll attach the minimal mapping doc we use for SAML attributes and a template for the SCIM token exchange.

Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Implementation, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Attachments referenced in Jira: redwood_attribute_mapping.md, scim-exchange-template.txt

From: Emma Liu <emma.liu@bankcrest.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-09T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Enterprise access onboarding: SSO/SCIM, IP allowlists & service-account playbook

Laura/Jordan —

Forwarding the token file (encoded) and a note from our security admin.

---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: security-admin@bankcrest.com
Date: Tue, 09 Mar 2027 16:35:00 -0500
Subject: Re: SCIM token for Redwood
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@bankcrest.com>

Token created with scoping: users:read, groups:read, users:write (limited). Rotation cadence: 7 days. Attached: scim-token-encoded.txt (one-time display).

-- security-admin

Emma

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@bankcrest.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-10T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Enterprise access onboarding: SSO/SCIM, IP allowlists & service-account playbook

Perfect — thanks Emma and security-admin. Confirming next steps from Redwood side:
- Vivek will import the SAML metadata into our staging connector on 2027-03-10 14:00 UTC and report attribute mismatches to the Jira ticket.
- We'll run a staged SCIM sync against a small subset of test users using the provided token; token will be stored in our vault and rotated per your 7-day cadence.
- Laura will own the IP allowlist coordination ticket; expect our egress CIDRs by 2027-03-11 EOD.

I'll set a 30-minute implementation sync for 2027-03-11 09:00 UTC — calendar invite forthcoming. If that time doesn't work for bankcrest infra, propose an alternate time here.

Thanks all — looking forward to a smooth staging cut.

Jordan
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Calendar: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/3b9e-onboard-sync
Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-9923
